mechanism.claim: A large BTC return left unexplained by the contemporaneous equal-weight liquid-alt factor during a high-variation completed block identifies BTC-specific information rather than broad crypto beta. Follow that residual direction for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the current causal BTC-on-alt-factor residual
mechanism.why_distinct: Cross-alt breadth relays use sign majorities, BTC disagreement, or magnitude underreaction without estimating BTC beta. Alt residual families trade market-neutral alt pairs and hold no BTC. HVEBCR models ETH residual on BTC. HVBFRR instead removes a causally fitted six-alt factor from BTC itself and trades the BTC-specific residual at one daily clock.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed BTC eight-hour realized-variation causal rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily 02:05 UTC beta-residual clock is absent from Gross9

features.block: exact eight-hour [D-8h,D) paths for BTCUSDT and six frozen alt perpetuals, each 480 unique coherent 1m bars
features.alt_factor: equal-weight arithmetic mean of six finite alt log returns
features.causal_fit: OLS BTC_return=a+b*alt_factor on at most 270 strictly prior source-valid daily blocks, minimum 180; current excluded
features.residual: current BTC return minus prior-only fitted value
features.residual_scale: sample standard deviation of prior fitted residuals over the same fit window, strict positive
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTC 1m log(close/open) returns across the block), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 prior source-valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact daily 02:00 UTC after all seven blocks complete
clock.reservation: daily opportunities are nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; funding after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no symbol panel, block, factor, fit, scale, residual threshold, variation, side, timing, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
